verdict.rationale: Slack's official slackapi/slack-api-specs repository publishes an OpenAPI 2.0 spec for the Web API covering public methods with user and bot tokens, plus AsyncAPI specs for the Events API. The probe's 404s at docs.slack.dev well-known paths only show the spec isn't hosted there; they don't contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. missing for 10: spec is the older OpenAPI 2.0 format, no evidence of how current or complete it is versus the 200+ live methods, and no discoverable spec at standard docs URLs.
